proposal.title: City of Avondale — CivicClerk Events OData API (agendas, minutes, meeting metadata)
proposal.note: This is the machine-readable source behind Avondale's own 'Browse All Public Meetings' portal linked from avondaleaz.gov — meeting notices, agendas and minutes for Council, Alamar CFD and all boards/commissions. Permission: ALLOWED — avondaleaz.portal.civicclerk.com robots.txt HTTP 200 with 'User-agent: *' and no Disallow (ALLOWED); the api subdomain returned NO_ROBOTS (no robots document, path may be opened).. Procedure: GET https://avondaleaz.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Events with OData query parameters ($orderby=startDateTime desc, $top=N, $filter on startDateTime or categoryId, e.g. categoryId eq 26 for City Council). JSON returns per-event id, eventName, startDateTime, eventCategoryName, eventLocation, publishedAgendaTimeStamp and publishedFiles[] with type ('Agenda'/'Minutes') and a stream/AVONDALEAZ/<guid>.pdf url path; fetch documents via the portal/file endpoint using those paths.. Evidence artifacts: ar-076cafa324f9aefa9dd5096f, ar-0f68bc6a16175d67a752232d, ar-9fc4fc57cc82d1f9ff9be92f. Unverified: The exact file-download endpoint that resolves stream/AVONDALEAZ/<guid>.pdf was not fetched.; robots.txt for the api host itself was reported NO_ROBOTS with no vaulted document id..

outcome.note: the candidate URL was opened in the Attempt and vaulted as ar-076cafa324f9aefa9dd5096f
